cs.content: Dva průběžné bodované testy v průběhu semestru. Možnost jedné opravy zápočtového testu (tentokrát již z celého učiva). Nutno získat 50 % bodů k udělení zápočtu. en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Acquirement of theoretical knowledge and basic calculation procedures in the field of descriptive statistics, assessment of relationships between numerical and categorical variables, description of time series and statistical comparisons as applied to social and economic processes. Skills to use statistical tools and functions of Microsoft Excell package.
